quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE Spaceborne Computer to power high performance computing (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE announced HPE Spaceborne Computer-4, a lightweight, fanless compute module with a low-power CPU and GPU and KIOXIA SSD flash storage, which plans to run AI workloads and what HPE calls the first high performance computing benchmarks on the lunar surface as a payload on Astrolab's FLIP rover; the mission is intended to launch in late 2026 under NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services initiative on Voyager Technologies' Griffin-1 lander, with NASA and Deloitte running AI workloads on it; HPE Private Cloud and HPE CloudOps Software will support Astrolab's mission control in Hawthorne, California (a planned technology test, not a commercial deployment).
